about: a board and two pawns: the smallest useful game

one of each thing the format says: image slabs and cells (one from the web, cached in assets; one as wide as its image), a cut-out, a model, a document piece, decks dealt and spread, loose and bagged cards, a bag of things, hands for seats, grids, traits, origin
tts-import's tiny fixture mod, as it translates it: a deck, loose cards, tiles, a token, models, a bag with things in it, a die document, a stack, a seat's hand, the table's snap points

a recipe: how many play and whether the extras are out (options), a seat taken away and one moved to a spot, things taken away by tag, a thing taken out of its bag, a kit for each seat; and its start: a shuffle, deals into the hands, a draw onto a market, who goes first
